title: Java Types in Kotlin
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of java types in kotlin using at least one correct term from the lesson.
Interpret or adapt a small Kotlin example that demonstrates java types in kotlin.
Identify one relevant edge case, debugging step, or version/platform constraint.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Java Types in Kotlin** as part of **Kotlin and Java Interoperability**. Kotlin and Java interoperate, but platform types, annotations, generated JVM signatures, and collection mutability require explicit boundary checks. Use the subtopics—Java Platform Types, Nullability Annotations, Generic Type Mapping—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Real projects depend on reliable error handling, modular organization, reproducible builds, and safe language boundaries. This lesson helps turn isolated syntax into maintainable applications.

items.title: Java Platform Types
items.text: Java Platform Types is one part of java types in kotlin. Connect its definition to the example, identify the input/state it changes, and verify the expected behavior with a small test case.

items.title: Nullability Annotations
items.text: Nullability Annotations is about representing or handling the possibility that a value is absent. Keep nullability visible in the type and choose an explicit fallback, branch, or result model rather than assuming the value exists.

items.title: Generic Type Mapping
items.text: Generic Type Mapping is best learned by tracing a small collection before and after the operation. Check ordering, duplicate handling, empty inputs, and whether the API returns a new value or mutates a mutable receiver.
